contract_question: R1 of the Birkhoff near-2D route: in the suitable-weak local-energy pressure-work term INT p (u.grad phi), does the pressure localization commutator [chi, Delta^-1] land entirely in the Calderon-Zygmund-controlled local part p_loc (cited Wolf 2015 / Seregin local pressure decomposition), so that p_har := p - p_loc is EXACTLY harmonic in Q_n and the incompressibility (div u=0) mean-cancellation INT (mean p_har)(u.grad phi)=0 is exact with NO uncontrolled O(1) commutator remainder in the harmonic-tail term? Success => R1 discharged, harmonic-tail pressure-work = oscillation-only <= C Lambda^-1 M ||u.grad phi||_1.
rationale_short: Wolf/Seregin local-pressure decompositions normally make the harmonic tail exact by construction; the remaining risk is a cutoff-regularity or formulation mismatch, not an O(1) commutator remainder. No DAG or separate boundary/domain witness was supplied, so I keep a residual on the exact hypotheses needed to justify the split.
